newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sees GDP growing about six pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sees GDP growing about six pct in 1996.

text.p: Singapore repeated on Thursday an earlier forecast that its gross domestic product (GDP) would grow by about six percent in 1996.
A statement by the Ministry of Trade and Industry said GDP would grow by between five and seven percent in 1997.
The forecasts were first announced on Tuesday in a speech given by deputy prime minister Lee Hsien Loong.
The ministry said the country's consumer price index (CPI) measuring inflation rose 1.4 percent year-on-year in the third quarter of 1996.
